Generated Narrative: CodeSystem em-responder-unit-type

This case-sensitive code system http://hie.go.ke/fhir/CodeSystem/em-responder-unit-type defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
ambulance AmbulanceA road vehicle equipped to provide emergency medical transport.
advanced-life-support Advanced life-support ambulanceAn ambulance equipped and staffed to provide advanced life support.
basic-life-support Basic life-support ambulanceAn ambulance equipped and staffed to provide basic life support.
patient-transport Patient transport vehicleA vehicle intended primarily for non-emergency patient transport.
rapid-response Rapid-response vehicleA response vehicle carrying emergency personnel and equipment but not normally transporting patients.
motorcycle Emergency-response motorcycleA motorcycle used to rapidly transport an emergency responder.
air-ambulance Air ambulanceA fixed-wing or rotary-wing aircraft used for emergency medical transport.
boat-ambulance Boat ambulanceA watercraft used for emergency medical response and transport.
command-unit Command unitA vehicle or mobile facility used to coordinate an emergency response.
other Other responder unitAnother type of emergency-response unit.
